explanation: `congr K v n` is the library's own congruence set. It is the set of 2×2 matrices over the completion whose four entries satisfy valuation bounds, written with the library's `lvl n := WithZero.exp (-(n+1))`. The theorem says this set shrinks as n grows. That follows immediately from the library lemma `lvl_succ_le`, which is monotonicity of `exp`, applied to each entry. So the result's content is in the library's own definitions. Mathlib has no matching congruence-subgroup filtration of GL₂ over an adic completion. The only Mathlib ingredients are generic order facts (`le_trans`, monotonicity of `WithZero.exp`), and those don't count.
